most_scoring_sections: Easy — agar facts yaad hain toh 28-32 marks confirm. Sab attempt karo.
Easy to Medium — definitions aur 2 points mein answer ho jaata hai

tips: Q1-Q5 ke sab 32 questions attempt karo — no negative marking, ek bhi blank mat chhodna
Q6-Q23 mein har question mein OR option hai — pehle dono padhkar aasaan wala choose karo
VSA mein 30 words — sirf 2 numbered points kaafi hain
Short answer mein 3 numbered points better than paragraph
Long answer mein intro + 4 numbered points + short conclusion — comparisons ke liye table banao (Tashkent vs Shimla)
Glasnost = Khullapan/Transparency, Perestroika = Punarnirman/Restructuring — yaad karo
EU flag mein 12 tare hain, 10 nahin — ASATYA likho T/F mein
Mandal Commission women se related NAHIN hai — OBC ke liye hai — ASATYA likho
Globalization rozgar kam karta hai — ASATYA (standard T/F question)
India's first nuclear test — 1974, second — 1998 — confuse mat karna (Match mein important)
Shimla 1972, Tashkent 1966 — dono confuse karna aasaan, dhyan rakho
Set number (A/B/C/D) answer sheet pe pehle clearly likho

time_allocation.note: 32 marks ke objective — 30 minutes. MCQ/Fill/T-F/Match/One sentence — sirf short answers likhna hai.
10 VSA x 2 marks. Har question 4 minutes max. 30 words — seedha 2 point.
4 short x 3 marks. 7-8 minutes each. Numbered points mein likho.
4 long x 4 marks. 10 minutes each. 120 words max. Intro + 4 points + conclusion.
Spellings check — Perestroika, Glasnost, Panchsheel, Tashkent, Hyderabad, Mohalanobis.

targets.strategy: Q1-Q5 objective mein 24-28 marks aasaan hain. Kuch VSA bhi attempt karo. Total 26+ comfortably.
focus_areas: Q1-Q5 sab attempt karo — no negative marking
Unit 15 (Emergency) — Press Censorship, 42nd Amendment definitions easy hain
Unit 13 (External Relations) — Tashkent aur Shimla samjhauta Long
Unit 6 (International Organizations) — UN ke ang + Security Council Long
Unit 15 (Emergency) — Short answer 3 parinaam ya 3 sabak

targets.strategy: Objective sab (32) + VSA sab (20) + Short 3-4 (9-12) + Long 3-4 (12-16) = 65-80.
focus_areas: India-China matbhed ke 4 karan — table format
Emergency ke parinaam aur sabak — 3-4 points each
UN organs + Security Council karya — bilkul yaad karo
